cited.quote: have been taken up for full coverage with water supply at 55 lpcd

rationale: C2 (policy note) says partially covered habitations have been taken up for full coverage, but gives no order or scheme dedicated to the remaining places. C4 is a drought-relief GO, a related but different step. C1 and C3 describe ongoing measures only. No dedicated official step shown.

cited.quote: All the 528 Town Panchayats are supplying drinking water at the rate of 70 LPCD.

rationale: The extracts are policy notes reporting existing supply levels, completed schemes and works under progress. None records an inauguration of water supply works in the remaining habitations or towns, or an official launch of a dedicated step. Related activity only.

cited.quote: orders have been issued for procurement of 2100 new buses (incliiding 100 small buses for Metropolitan
Government have ordered for procurement of 208 Mini Buses at a cost of Rs.35 Crores

rationale: C2 recounts the GO dated 15.03.2017 sanctioning procurement of 2100 buses including 100 small buses for MTC in 2016-17, and C1 reports ordered procurement of 208 mini buses for hill areas. These are official measures for small and mini buses; new permits are not shown. The GO covers small buses only as part of a larger order, so doubt remains.

cited.quote: the Metropolitan Transport Corporation (Chennai) Limited is operating 150 Small buses on 69 routes

rationale: C1, C2 and C3 are policy notes describing small buses and hill-area mini buses already operating; none shows a notification or dated order launching new mini-bus routes across districts. C4 and C5 concern low-floor buses, a different subject.

cited.quote: be continued for a further period of three years from 01-06-2018

rationale: C4 is a Finance Department GO dated 17 July 2018 directing that the existing Scheme of Advances for Education of Government Employees' children be continued for three more years. This matches the indicator (an order to continue an existing scheme). C1 and C3 only state intent to continue. The promise's scheme set is vague.

cited.quote: Adoption of Revised guidelines issued by the Government of India

rationale: C4 is a GO dated 2018-07-09 adopting revised guidelines for the post-matric scholarship for Adi Dravidar students with effect from April 2018, an official guideline issued to refine an existing welfare scheme. C1 describes monitoring only; C2, C3 and C5 are COVID guidelines.

cited.quote: permit to continue the scheme for the period from 1.4.2016 to 31.3.2017
The Government has launched an ambitious Food Grain Mission revitalized with crop specific strategies

rationale: C4 is a GO of 2016-07-04 sanctioning the Blue Green Algae production and distribution scheme for 2016-17, an early dated official step. C3 reports the Government has launched a Food Grain Mission and other production schemes, without dates. C2 is only budget intent. Evidence of launches is thin and mostly undated.

cited.quote: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana(PMFBY) is implemented from Kharif, 2016 onwards in all the districts of Tamil Nadu

rationale: C3 reports the crop insurance scheme PMFBY, a farmer-welfare scheme, implemented in all districts from Kharif 2016 with state premium share; C1 and C2 agree. C4 and C5 are further farmer-oriented GOs. Only the year is given for the start, so the date is year-level.

cited.quote: The ULBs aim to implement water supply schemes with the objective of achieving these norms.

rationale: C1, C2 and C3 are policy notes citing CPHEEO norms (135/90 LPCD) and projects under way, not a WHO standard, and show no order directed at that standard. C4 is a rural sanitation policy and C5 concerns old age homes; neither is about this commitment.

cited.quote: various Water supply and UGSS Internal Plumbing projects were sanctioned to Corporations / Municipalities during 2018-19

rationale: C3 reports water supply projects sanctioned to Corporations and Municipalities in 2018-19 from the UIDSSMT revolving fund (Rs.169.58 crore), and 28 water supply projects sanctioned under the relaunched IUDM. For a directional commitment this counts as a dedicated sanction. The exact date is not given, so only the start year of 2018-19 is used.

cited.quote: from Little Mount to Chennai Airport and from Alandur to St.Thomas Mount on 21.9.2016

rationale: C3 states that passenger services from Little Mount to Chennai Airport and from Alandur to St.Thomas Mount were inaugurated on 21.9.2016, in the same year as promised. C1 (2016) had expected the inauguration the following month. Little Mount is taken as the English name of Chinnamalai.

cited.quote: Totally 400 Sub-centres were created at a cost of Rs.12.45 crore in the past 9 years.

rationale: C1, C2 and C3 report sub-centres created and dispensaries opened or upgraded, but only as cumulative figures since 2011-12 with no dated order or launch inside this term. C4 and C5 are unrelated GOs. No dated official step by this government is shown.

cited.quote: a Special Vocational Guidance Centre is functioning at Udhagamandalam in the Nilgiris District

rationale: C2 mentions an existing vocational guidance centre and ITIs for tribal youth, and C3 lists TAHDCO training and loan schemes, but none shows new employment centres in universities, institutions or districts for Adi Dravidars and tribals. C4 and C5 are administrative GOs.

cited.quote: To conduct Bridge Course training under Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL) concept for three days
So far 43,000 construction workers have been imparted training.

rationale: C5 is a GO of 2019-09-09 sanctioning RPL bridge-course training and certification for 5000 construction workers; C4 reports 43,000 construction workers trained; C2 reports 2,27,106 youth trained over five years. Skill training with certification exists, but nothing near 15 lakh workers. C1 mentions an earlier RPL sanction in 2016-17 without a date.

cited.quote: Upgradation of 39 Primary Health Centres/Upgraded primary Health Centres/ Government Non-Taluk Hospitals as Government Taluk Hospitals
166 PHCs have been upgraded with 30 beds, Ultra Sonogram, Operation Theatre facility, etc.,

rationale: C4 is the GO dated 23.09.2016 sanctioning upgradation of 39 PHCs and non-taluk hospitals into Taluk Hospitals. C3 reports 254 new PHCs and 166 PHCs upgraded with 30 beds, and C1 reports new PHCs established and 30-bed upgrades in 2016-17. Both parts of the promise are shown as implemented.

cited.quote: administrative approval was accorded for the implementation of the Coconut Development Board assisted schemes
Rs. 1.00 Crore was spent for the production of 3.25 Lakh of hybrid coconut seedlings

rationale: C5 shows the first-read GO dated 06.07.2016 giving administrative approval for Coconut Development Board schemes in 2016-17, including the integrated farming for productivity scheme. C2 reports 3.25 lakh hybrid coconut seedlings produced and distributed, and C1 and C5 give further sanctions. Both elements of the promise are covered.

cited.quote: the risk on account of change of tax law in Government works contracts due to introduction of the GST

rationale: C1, C2 and C4 are GST payment orders for existing government works contracts, a neighbouring subject. None provides work contracts for small works to certificate holders. C3 (child labour) and C5 (PWD services) are unrelated. No official step for this commitment shown.

cited.quote: The Virtual Learning System Portal was launched by the Hon’ble Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu on 22.02.2019

rationale: C1 reports the Virtual Learning System Portal, offering online free coaching classes, e-content and e-books for competitive-exam aspirants, launched by the Chief Minister on 22.02.2019, plus a career guidance centre with a virtual classroom. This is an official launch of online lessons aimed at obtaining employment. Not a GO, so some doubt.

cited.quote: The Virtual Learning System Portal was launched by the Hon’ble Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu on 22.02.2019

rationale: C3 reports the Virtual Learning System Portal for e-learning, e-content and online virtual learning videos for job-exam aspirants, launched by the Chief Minister on 22.02.2019. This is an online portal for employment-oriented lessons. C1 and C2 only describe other portals or plans.
